items.title: Evacuees from Russia-occupied city where residents ate weeds arrive in Ukraine
items.description: Residents left the devastated city on Friday following a ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump.

items.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
items.description: The American-made interceptors are the only effective weapon for downing Russia's ballistic missiles.

items.title: Why North Korea's 'elite' hackers are the prime suspect in major Binance hack
items.description: If the accusations are true, the record-making heist shows how powerful suspected North Korean hackers have become.

items.title: Police deployed during stand-off over control of top Poland court
items.description: The escalation came after the government suspended two senior justices and moved to bring criminal charges against them.

items.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
items.description: The Spanish PM is hit by a succession of crises just weeks before a snap general election.

items.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
items.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband  confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

items.title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue
items.description: Countries have been trying to get a global agreement to halt nature decline back on track.

items.title: They strangled us, says founder of Russian newspaper shut under pressure from authorities
items.description: Novaya Gazeta has been one of the most high-profile independent news outlets in Russia over the last three decades.

items.title: The fight to save Canadian town threatened by Trump's tariffs
items.description: A century-old paper mill in Témiscaming, Quebec is indefinitely closed after the US imposed 50% tariffs on its products, putting hundreds out of work.

items.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
items.description: The cyber-attack, which the company describes as complex, is believed to be the largest ever of its kind.

items.title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
items.description: It is Pike's first public statement since she survived an execution attempt by lethal injection in September.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a US election
items.description: The Chicago-born pontiff, who has a tense relationship with Trump, mailed in a ballot for the midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.
